subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: For vLLM/local providers whose token usage is present but pricing is missing or all zero, should the Usage page show token-only/missing-cost state, require configured local cost, or add another provider pricing contract?
rationale: The code already requests and aggregates vLLM-compatible token usage, but without the reporter's raw payloads maintainers must decide whether any remaining cost gap belongs to the existing unknown-pricing contract instead of a new automated vLLM fix.

options.title: Request evidence first
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a raw vLLM stream, transcript usage row, `sessions.usage`, `usage.cost`, screenshot, and pricing config before changing product behavior.

options.title: Route cost-only gap to canonical pricing issue
options.body: If new evidence shows tokens are recorded but cost is missing or zero, treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674 as the canonical remaining work.

options.title: Sponsor local pricing UX
options.body: Define a new explicit vLLM/local-model pricing setup or warning experience before implementation if maintainers want more than token-only display.

recommendation.title: Request evidence first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a raw vLLM stream, transcript usage row, `sessions.usage`, `usage.cost`, screenshot, and pricing config before changing product behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete appears in the relevant usage-cost, vLLM streaming-usage, and zero-rate cost history and is the best available routing owner for the product contract choice.
